verdicts.reason: I can't tell these two apart in any way that matters. They differ only by a few pixels in vertical position. Both have the same faults: 'J'adore Paris' sits on the frame's top border, and 'LOTION' is crammed against the bottom edge of the label. The original's grouped row of products is broken up into a lone bottle and a floating sachet set out on a diagonal, which leaves a large empty band in the middle and a crowded pile at the bottom.
